acceptance_holds: V9 preserves the complete accepted V8 exterior, complementary seam clearances, rear-bezel service path, bottom-keel partition, V0.5-M2 rear interface, rail axes, socket datums, M4 retention, and selected wrapped-panel landing polygons.
No integrated retention feature may cross a body seam. The four body shells must seat through the complete V8 assembly paths before any removable bridge is installed.
Every bridge uses one broad 12 mm cylindrical insert pad on each shell, one M3 heat-set insert per pad, and one M3 x 8 socket-cap screw per bridge end.
The 4.1 mm pilot is a controlled starting dimension for a nominal 4.6 x 5.7 mm insert. A printed ASA insert coupon and the actual purchased insert must pass before final body-shell printing.
Only the allowlisted lower-center bridge may trigger localized internal clearance relief, and its pre-relief overlap must remain at or below 12 mm3 per affected shell.
Every bridge, driver envelope, body shell, rear bezel, bottom keel, socket cap, and complete M2 aluminum envelope must be collision checked in seated and service states.
All five bridges are separate printable service parts and every production STL must contain exactly one closed manifold component.
A support/brim-inclusive Prusa MK4 Generic ASA slice with at least 10 mm XY margin is required for all thirteen V9 printed parts.
V9 resolves only final body-shell seam retention. Physical shell fit, ears, eyes, glow modules, lamp and steering portals, and final integrated ASA authorization remain separate blockers.

exact_thirteen_part_set.summation_method: exact sum of independently orientation-searched and real-sliced four V9 body shells, rear bezel, bottom keel, two socket caps, and five removable body-seam bridges
